title: Transfers popup respects your workspace layout
description:
If you hide the Transfers panel in a workspace, starting an upload, billable package copy, or any cloud move/copy will no longer force that panel back open. Transfers continue to run in the background exactly as before, they just won't reopen a popup you deliberately closed.

Who is affected: everyone on the private server, and on SaaS after Push. Workspaces that keep the Transfers panel visible (the default) are unchanged.
changeLog: Transfers panel no longer auto-opens on transfer start if you hid it for that workspace.
Uploads, billable package copies, and cloud moves still run and track progress in the background when the panel is hidden.
